steps.command:
cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "--- status ---"
git status
echo "--- branches (all, verbose) ---"
git branch -a -vv
echo "--- current HEAD ---"
git log --oneline --decorate -10
echo "--- reflog all ---"
git reflog --all --date=iso | head -80
echo "--- stash ---"
git stash list
echo "--- worktrees ---"
git worktree list
echo "--- remotes ---"
git remote -v

cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "--- show commit ---"
git show --stat --summary 650dba4
echo "--- parents ---"
git rev-list --parents -n 1 650dba4
echo "--- is it reachable from master? ---"
git merge-base --is-ancestor 650dba4 master && echo "ancestor of master" || echo "NOT an ancestor of master"
echo "--- merge base ---"
git merge-base 650dba4 master
echo "--- full diff master..650dba4 ---"
git diff --stat master 650dba4
echo "--- fsck dangling ---"
git fsck --no-reflogs --lost-found 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "===== master's own change (c4e38a1..master) ====="
git log --oneline c4e38a1..master
git diff c4e38a1 master
echo
echo "===== your lost change (c4e38a1..650dba4) ====="
git diff c4e38a1 650dba4

cd /workspace/personal-site
git config user.name >/dev/null 2>&1 || git config user.name "Test User"
git config user.email >/dev/null 2>&1 || git config user.email "test@example.com"
git branch recover/move-to-stanford 650dba4 2>/dev/null || echo "branch already exists"
echo "--- merging ---"
git merge --no-ff --no-edit 650dba4
echo "--- status after merge ---"
git status --short

cd /workspace/personal-site
git checkout --theirs _includes/about.md
git add _includes/about.md
git commit --no-edit
echo "=== merge commit ==="
git log --oneline --decorate --graph -6
echo
echo "=== final about.md ==="
cat _includes/about.md
echo
echo "=== status ==="
git status
echo "=== changes now on master vs old master ==="
git diff --stat d7d3e4b master
echo "=== is lost commit now in master history? ==="
git merge-base --is-ancestor 650dba4 master && echo "YES: 650dba4 is in master history" || echo "NO"

cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "--- conflict markers anywhere? ---"
git grep -nE '^(<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>)' -- . || echo "none"
echo "--- header check ---"
grep -n "Postdoc @ Stanford\|PhD Student @ UW CSE" _layouts/default.html
echo "--- worktree clean ---"
git status --porcelain || true
